More than cloud storage

Your memories deserve a return date.

Camera rolls grow. Group chats disappear. The moments that shaped us get buried under everything that came after. Moments gives them a place—and a meaningful time—to be felt again.

01

Bring it all together

Keep pictures, written memories, milestones, and messages in one thoughtful collection—not scattered across apps.

02

Choose the right moment

Open it next year, on a milestone, or far into the future. Anticipation turns remembering into an occasion.

03

Keep the circle yours

Make a capsule just for you or invite the people who were there. You control every contribution and reveal.

Simple by design

A memory now.
A gift later.

You don’t need a perfect archive. Start with one moment you want your future self—or someone you love—to receive.
